name: aprs-webchat
description: Web-based APRS messaging dashboard for Direwolf (KISS TCP) and APRS-IS
author: Luis Almonte (HI3LAG)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
